title: Kagamine Len — In Her Time Of Need〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to stay here for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Kanade said that she'd try talking with Mafuyu's dad, but...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Why the long face?
Need a kind, sisterly shoulder to lean on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rich, coming from you of all people...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seemed happy to watch Len wallow around for what felt like forever.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just waiting for the opportune moment to speak to him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, Len, what's bothering you so much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You wondered who'd come over to SEKAI, and it turned out to be Mafuyu. Still, I wasn't expecting to hear that things had gotten so bad.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because she hasn't been able to express her true thoughts and feelings, she's being compelled to accept her mother's ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's basically back to where she was before she left home.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, so... She said she'd try contacting Mafuyu's dad.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. She wants to check up on things without being obvious about it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu seemed happy just a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't Miku go over to check up on her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku said that she seemed okay, and that she even smiled a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But wasn't this all just to be expected?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If this whole mess could be resolved this easily, then Mafuyu wouldn't have been in that state in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If only... If only we'd been by her side a little more...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then we might've been able to keep whatever happened from happening. Is that what you're thinking, Len?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you do understand the position we're in here, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know. We're not allowed to be seen by anyone besides Mafuyu and the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe, just maybe, things would be alright if they learned that we exist...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they can never know about SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. I mean, this place is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: One of the few places where Mafuyu can take refuge.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A place where she can feel at ease.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If Mafuyu were to lose this place, then she'd probably...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I... I want to help Mafuyu somehow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you want to help her, then there's no time for tears.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. Every second is precious right now. We should be spending that time thinking of ways to help her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (MEIKO and Luka are both so warm today for some reason...)
